Vision VP/CD includes UV led as a condition without shown baseline context.

Row NG rate!39 is cited but not included in provided context.
Decision row/context after row55 is not captured.

correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to Normal vs Test machine UC press VP/CD where directly compared.
Keep UV led normal/UV dry as supporting context or separate only if row evidence proves comparison.
Correct tension spec to ≥0.5 Kgf and mark both Test machine and Normal as OK, not violations.
Add or remove NG rate!39 based on its actual row content.
Include final decision rows if present before approval.
